properties.name: Naver / Nvidia AI Data Center — Nouaceur
properties.description: A landmark $1.2B facility announced by South Korean tech giant Naver in partnership with Nvidia. Located in Nouaceur near Mohammed V Airport, this 500 MW campus will be one of Africa's largest AI-ready data centers. Anchors Morocco's ambition to become a continental AI compute hub and signals significant hyperscaler confidence in North African infrastructure.

properties.name: Iozera AI Hub — Tetouan
properties.description: A $500M AI-focused campus planned for Eureka Park in Tetouan, near the Strait of Gibraltar. Targets 386 MW IT load, leveraging proximity to submarine cable landings and the Spain-Morocco power interconnect. Positions Morocco's northern coast as a low-latency bridge between European cloud regions and African markets.

properties.name: Sovereign Data Center — Dakhla
properties.description: Sovereign data center planned for Dakhla under Morocco's Digital Strategy 2030. Would leverage the region's world-class wind and solar resources for near-100% renewable power. If the 2Africa cable landing at Dakhla is confirmed, this facility could catalyze a green AI corridor from sub-Saharan Africa to Europe.

properties.name: Government Data Center — Rabat Technopolis
properties.description: Sovereign cloud facility at Rabat Technopolis for government services, citizen data, and AI research under Moroccan data sovereignty regulations. Powered by a dedicated 33 kV ONEE feeder with rooftop solar and battery backup. First node in Morocco's sovereign cloud infrastructure.

properties.name: Casablanca Carrier-Neutral Data Center
properties.description: Casablanca's primary carrier-neutral colocation facility and home to the country's main Internet Exchange Point (IX-MOR). Serves Moroccan ISPs, CDN providers, and enterprise cloud customers. The 2Africa cable landing at Casablanca has significantly boosted this facility's strategic value for hyperscalers exploring North African PoPs.
